game.title: Valiant Hearts: The Great War
game.blurb: Side-scrolling puzzle adventure set in World War I, from Ubisoft Montpellier, published by Ubisoft Entertainment, released 2014-06-24. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Adventure, Puzzle. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Story: Training to the Zeppelin
chapters.summary: Basic training, the tractor, the zeppelin crash and getting Karl out from under it.

chapters.title: The Story: Douaumont to the Escape
chapters.summary: The Douaumont Fort mission, the Baron Von Dorf and escaping with Anna and Karl. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Story: The Ending
chapters.summary: Reaching the end of the game. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Battlefield Moments
chapters.summary: Optional feats along the way: the bell in Ypres, the laundry bags, the Somme, the cannon at Vimy's ridge, the dog, a clean taxi mission and a perfect third rescue of Karl.

chapters.title: Historical Items and Facts
chapters.summary: Finding the historical items and reading the historical facts.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 1758). Steam app 260230 ("Valiant Hearts: The Great War™ / Soldats Inconnus : Mémoires de la Grande Guerre™") was used. None of the 20 Steam achievements is hidden. The three story chapters follow the Steam list order of VHTGW_Ach_1 to VHTGW_Ach_9, which reads like story order but is not confirmed by the data; the places in the optional feats (Ypres, the Somme, Vimy's ridge) are not placed in order. StrategyWiki has no page under "Valiant Hearts: The Great War" or "Valiant Hearts". valianthearts.fandom.com answers the API with 7 linked articles (including Achievements, the main character names and "Valiant Hearts: Dogs of War"); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
